#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 1b: BCS-Controlled FewRel Accuracy — compact single-panel grouped bar.

L0: Matches Fig 1a styling (ACL/EMNLP IE paper)
L1: Okabe-Ito, no grid, no top/right spines, >=7pt, PDF TrueType
L2: Δ annotations with white stroke, semantic colors (blue=low-BCS/good, amber=high-BCS/bad)
L3: Pattern D (hollow vs solid for 80-pool subset), Pattern F (label offsets)
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 7,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.03,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

C_LOW  = '#56B4E9'   # Okabe-Ito sky blue — low BCS (better)
C_HIGH = '#E69F00'   # Okabe-Ito amber — high BCS (worse)

# --- Data (count_8, extreme-batch Low/High BCS) ---
conditions = ['16-rel\n(indep.)', '40-rel\n(80-pool)', '80-rel']
low_bcs  = np.array([0.889, 0.833, 0.823])
high_bcs = np.array([0.798, 0.500, 0.510])
deltas   = low_bcs - high_bcs  # [0.091, 0.333, 0.312]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 2.5))

x = np.arange(len(conditions))
w = 0.30

bars_lo = ax.bar(x - w/2, low_bcs, w, color=C_LOW, edgecolor='white',
                 linewidth=0.4, zorder=2, label='Low BCS')
bars_hi = ax.bar(x + w/2, high_bcs, w, color=C_HIGH, edgecolor='white',
                 linewidth=0.4, zorder=2, label='High BCS')

# Pattern D: hatch the 40-rel bars (80-pool subset condition)
bars_lo[1].set_hatch('///')
bars_lo[1].set_edgecolor(C_LOW)
bars_hi[1].set_hatch('///')
bars_hi[1].set_edgecolor(C_HIGH)

# Value labels on bars
for bars in [bars_lo, bars_hi]:
    for bar in bars:
        h = bar.get_height()
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, h + 0.012,
                f'{h:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6)

# Δ annotations between bar pairs
for i, d in enumerate(deltas):
    mid_y = (low_bcs[i] + high_bcs[i]) / 2
    t = ax.text(x[i], mid_y, f'$\\Delta$={d*100:.1f}pp',
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
                color='#333333',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', fc='white',
                          ec='#cccccc', alpha=0.9, linewidth=0.4))

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(conditions)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
ax.set_ylim(0.0, 1.05)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='none', handlelength=1.2)

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
outdir = os.environ.get('FIG_OUTDIR',
    '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_18/projects/schema-dag-extraction/figures/paper')
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
outpath = os.path.join(outdir, 'fig_bcs_scaling.pdf')
fig.savefig(outpath, format='pdf')
fig.savefig(outpath.replace('.pdf', '.png'), format='png', dpi=300)
print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
plt.close()

"""Figure 2: Error Taxonomy — dual-panel line plots.

Replaces stacked bars with line plots to emphasize monotonic IntraSub scaling.
L0: Matches Fig 1 styling (ACL/EMNLP IE paper)
L1: Okabe-Ito, no grid, no top/right spines, >=7pt, PDF TrueType
L2: Semantic line styles (solid=IntraSub, dashed=missed/other), insight annotations
L3: Pattern B (fill_between for IntraSub growth), Pattern F (label offsets)
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 6.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.03,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.4,
    'lines.markersize': 5,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

C_INTRA  = '#D55E00'   # Okabe-Ito vermillion — IntraSub (type confusion)
C_MISSED = '#0072B2'   # Okabe-Ito blue — Missed / ExtraSub
C_OTHER  = '#999999'   # Gray — Other errors / Correct
stroke = [pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')]

fig, (ax_ner, ax_re) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.75, 2.5))

# ========== (a) Few-NERD NER ==========
bins_ner = ['Solo\n(BCS=0)', 'Low\n(0.5–0.7)', 'Med\n(0.7–0.8)', 'High\n(≥0.95)']
x_ner = np.arange(len(bins_ner))
intra_ner  = np.array([0.0, 1.6, 10.6, 49.4])
extra_ner  = np.array([90.3, 80.0, 65.0, 30.8])
other_ner  = 100.0 - intra_ner - extra_ner

ax_ner.plot(x_ner, intra_ner, 'o-', color=C_INTRA, label='IntraSub', zorder=3)
ax_ner.plot(x_ner, extra_ner, 's--', color=C_MISSED, label='ExtraSub', zorder=3)
ax_ner.plot(x_ner, other_ner, '^:', color=C_OTHER, label='Other', zorder=2,
            markersize=4, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7)

# Fill under IntraSub to emphasize growth
ax_ner.fill_between(x_ner, 0, intra_ner, color=C_INTRA, alpha=0.08, zorder=1)

# Annotations
t = ax_ner.text(3, intra_ner[3] + 3, f'{intra_ner[3]:.0f}%', fontsize=6.5,
                color=C_INTRA, ha='center', fontweight='bold')
t.set_path_effects(stroke)
t = ax_ner.text(0.3, extra_ner[0] - 5, f'{extra_ner[0]:.0f}%', fontsize=6.5,
                color=C_MISSED, ha='left')
t.set_path_effects(stroke)

# Insight annotation
t = ax_ner.text(1.5, 75, 'ExtraSub dominates\nat low BCS', fontsize=6,
                color=C_MISSED, ha='center', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)
t.set_path_effects(stroke)

ax_ner.set_xticks(x_ner)
ax_ner.set_xticklabels(bins_ner)
ax_ner.set_xlabel('BCS Bin')
ax_ner.set_ylabel('Error Share (%)')
ax_ner.set_ylim(-3, 100)
ax_ner.set_title('(a) Few-NERD NER', fontsize=9, pad=4)
ax_ner.legend(loc='center right', framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='none')

# ========== (b) FewRel RE ==========
bins_re = ['Solo\n(BCS=0)', 'Low\n(0.565)', 'Med\n(0.729)', 'High\n(0.86)', 'V.High\n(0.971)']
x_re = np.arange(len(bins_re))
correct_re = np.array([85.73, 85.42, 75.70, 66.67, 52.03])
wrong_re   = np.array([0.0, 4.17, 13.0, 20.28, 32.25])
missed_re  = np.array([14.27, 10.42, 11.3, 13.05, 15.71])

ax_re.plot(x_re, wrong_re, 'o-', color=C_INTRA, label='WrongType', zorder=3)
ax_re.plot(x_re, missed_re, 's--', color=C_MISSED, label='Missed', zorder=3)
ax_re.plot(x_re, correct_re, '^:', color=C_OTHER, label='Correct', zorder=2,
           markersize=4, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7)

# Fill under WrongType to emphasize growth
ax_re.fill_between(x_re, 0, wrong_re, color=C_INTRA, alpha=0.08, zorder=1)

# Annotations
t = ax_re.text(4, wrong_re[4] + 3, f'{wrong_re[4]:.0f}%', fontsize=6.5,
               color=C_INTRA, ha='center', fontweight='bold')
t.set_path_effects(stroke)
t = ax_re.text(2, missed_re[2] + 3, 'flat', fontsize=6,
               color=C_MISSED, ha='center', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)
t.set_path_effects(stroke)

# Insight annotation
t = ax_re.text(3.5, 58, 'type substitution\nscales with BCS', fontsize=6,
               color=C_INTRA, ha='center', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)
t.set_path_effects(stroke)

ax_re.set_xticks(x_re)
ax_re.set_xticklabels(bins_re)
ax_re.set_xlabel('BCS Bin')
ax_re.set_ylabel('Share (%)')
ax_re.set_ylim(-3, 100)
ax_re.set_title('(b) FewRel RE', fontsize=9, pad=4)
ax_re.legend(loc='center right', framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='none')

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=1.5, pad=0.3)
outdir = os.environ.get('FIG_OUTDIR',
    '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_18/projects/schema-dag-extraction/figures/paper')
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
outpath = os.path.join(outdir, 'fig_error_taxonomy.pdf')
fig.savefig(outpath, format='pdf')
fig.savefig(outpath.replace('.pdf', '.png'), format='png', dpi=300)
print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
plt.close()
